reviewed_by: Codex focused review for accessible follow-up queue controls
reason: The change moves the durable follow-up queue out of the bounded goal/subagent context scroller so expanding a queued item immediately exposes its Core-backed controls. The selected component checks retain the queue disclosure contract; the exact mocked journey now stacks an active goal, active subagent and queued messages and verifies visible pause, edit and clear controls across the permanent desktop and mobile viewport matrix; the dedicated production-LAN real-Core journey proves paused enqueue, edit, refresh persistence and removal against durable Core state.
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. Backend Python, Rust/native code, storage schema, queue dispatch semantics, provider routing and unrelated interface journeys are unchanged. The shared Playwright config and impact catalog changes only enroll the exact follow-up-queue regression in the missing permanent 1024, 320, 390 and 430 px projects; those eight catalogued entries plus one isolated real-Core entry are the reviewed browser boundary.
